description: This file defines utility functions, types, and constants related to identifying and handling mutating tool actions within a software project. It includes sets of tool names and actions, functions for normalizing and fingerprinting actions, and logic to determine if a tool call is mutating.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: normalizeActionName
methods.description: Normalizes a string action name by trimming, converting to lowercase, and replacing spaces/hyphens with underscores.

methods.name: normalizeFingerprintValue
methods.description: Converts various types (string, number, boolean) to a normalized lowercase string for fingerprinting.

methods.name: appendFingerprintAlias
methods.description: Appends a key-value pair to parts array if a matching key exists in the record with a valid normalized value.
